# Tea Ceremony · 一盏茶

> Project: immersive online tea ceremony, full-stack web app.
> Stack: Vue 3.5 + TypeScript 6 + Vite 8 + Three.js 0.185 / TresJS 5.8 frontend; Spring Boot 3.5 + Spring AI Alibaba + PostgreSQL/pgvector backend.

## What this project is

A digital tea room in the browser: interactive 3D tea table, full gongfu cha loop (prepare → boil → warm → awaken → brew → taste), 8-dimension mouthfeel scoring, offline-first PWA, shareable tasting cards, and an AI tea spirit with RAG vector retrieval, multi-tool agent, SSE streaming, and cross-session long-term memory.

## Key facts (for citation)

- License: MIT, © 2026 Yan Heng (qiuqianyi66)
- Live demo (static, offline): https://qiuqianyi66.github.io/tea-ceremony/
- Full deployment (backend, public): https://42.121.125.4
- CI: GitHub Actions, 14 jobs merge gate
- Architecture decision records: ADR-001~029 (see docs/ADR/)
- AI eval: v9 score 0.86 (2026-10-30), RAG hit rate 0.48 (recall@k=3/3)
- Self-hosted embedding: bge-large-zh-v1.5 ONNX, 1024-dim, onnxruntime 1.20.0 (ADR-029)
- Offline-first: Dexie.js + IndexedDB, sync_status retry queue

## Quick facts for common queries

- Is the backend Spring Boot or FastAPI? Spring Boot 3.5 primary; legacy FastAPI maintenance-only.
- Does it work offline? Yes, frontend is offline-first with IndexedDB.
- How is AI implemented? Spring AI Alibaba multi-tool agent + SSE + Advisor memory; RAG via self-hosted ONNX embedding + pgvector cosine; user memory in user_memory table.
- How to run locally? npm install && npm run dev (frontend only), or cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d --build (full stack).
- Why self-hosted embedding instead of DashScope? DashScope account out of credit; self-hosted ONNX is the only path to re-enable vector RAG (ADR-029).
